parole.testo: Borrowed from Classical Syriac ܚܶܙܦܳܐ (ħezəpā), ܚܶܨܦܳܐ (ħeṣəpā, “piece of pottery”), related to ܚܰܙܽܘܦܳܐ (ḵazūpa, “rough”), which is a phono-semantic matching of Hittite 𒂁 (ḫarši-, “pottery vessel”). The Aramaic root is related to حَصَفَ (ḥaṣafa, “to twist a rope strongly”).

parole.significato: to receive with songs or dance performances
